_comment: Scoped permissions for the unattended report-digest watcher (scripts/digest_watcher.sh).
Deliberately NOT --dangerously-skip-permissions: this agent is triggered by whatever PDF
lands in the Dropbox inbox, and a report is untrusted input. A PDF containing prompt-injection
text should not be able to reach the network, rewrite source code, or run arbitrary shell.
Everything here is the minimum the digest pipeline needs. Widen it only deliberately.
